description: This source file defines a static class 'ResponseCompletionSourcePool' for managing object pooling of ResponseCompletionSource objects, both typed and untyped, within the Orleans.Serialization.Invocation namespace. It includes methods to get and return pooled objects, facilitating efficient resource reuse in serialization operations.
